description:
Because:
- fxa-event-broker used a logger and ExtendedError copy in fxa-shared/nestjs.
- @fxa/shared/mozlog already has the logger.

This commit:
- Imports MozLoggerService and MozLoggerModule from @fxa/shared/mozlog.
- Calls setContext('default') in PubsubProxyController and QueueworkerService.
- Moves ExtendedError to fxa-event-broker/src/extended-error.ts.
- Adds the mozlog path to tsconfig.build.json and updates the README.
- Deletes fxa-shared/nestjs/logger and fxa-shared/nestjs/error.ts.

Closes FXA-10666
